name: Essence Flux

abilities.text: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. If it's a Spirit, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

notes: APPROXIMATION: no condition asks whether the returned card is a Spirit, so the +1/+1 counter is put on the returned creature whatever its subtypes (see needs).

issues: If it's a Spirit, put a +1/+1 counter on it. — expected the +1/+1 counter goes on only if the returned permanent is a Spirit — scripted unconditional counters op on 'that' (script notes admit this). Blind scenarios confirm two failures: Grizzly Bears gained a +1/+1 counter (P/T 3/3 instead of 2/2) and Wall of Omens gained one — CR CR 608.2a — the 'if' clause is checked on resolution and gates the dependent effect

If it's a Spirit, put a +1/+1 counter on it. — expected the +1/+1 counter is placed only when the returned permanent is a Spirit — scripted unconditional counters op on 'that' (self-disclosed approximation). Blind scenarios confirm: Grizzly Bears returned as a 3/3 with a +1/+1 counter, Wall of Omens likewise — CR 608.2a

Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control — expected exile and return; the returned object is new (counters, auras, damage gone), enters under OWNER's control — scripted exile target {kind:'creature', controller:'you'} then return-to-battlefield target:'that' underControlOf:'owner' — correct, and the blink/ETB-retrigger half works in the scenarios; only the Spirit condition is broken — CR 400.7, 111.7
